annotation.authors_or_issuer: Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence, National Science and Technology Council (White House OSTP)
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets eight strategic priorities for federal AI R&D investment, adding a new Strategy 8 on public-private partnerships.
Explicitly excludes policy and regulatory recommendations on AI governance or deployment; it addresses R&D priorities only.
Calls for research on more capable and reliable robots, including safe human-robot collaboration.
Prioritizes AI safety, security, explainability, verification and validation, and ethics-by-design research.
Supports AI technical standards, benchmarks and testbeds, including NIST robot test methods and ASTM E54.
annotation.summary_en: The 2019 update of the US National AI R&D Strategic Plan sets eight priorities for federal AI research investment, adding public-private partnerships. It stresses trustworthy, safe, explainable AI, standards and workforce. It expressly avoids regulatory recommendations. Robotics and automated vehicles appear as research areas, not as governance subjects.
